```{r}
project_root <- "R/data_cleaned.R"

old_wd <- getwd()
setwd(project_root)
tryCatch(
  source("R/data_cleaned.R"),
  finally = setwd(old_wd)
)

mlr_model <- lm(
  interest_rate ~ applicant_age + income + loan_amount + property_value,
  data = pima_hmda_clean
)

summary(mlr_model)
```
